trend-dominated with moderate ranking suggests a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models and improve robustness.

Test a weighted combination with softmax_neg_error weights, as a different weighting scheme to the previously used inverse_error, to see if it better handles the moderate ranking stability and correlated error groups.
test a weighted combination using forward selection weights to see if greedy selection improves over softmax.
The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability; a simple DBA with limited iterations may exploit the trend and seasonality without overfitting.
test a plain mean over the full model pool
per‑horizon top‑k weighted on trend‑dominated pool4
use robust median over trend‑dominated pool

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8815. Series context: trend strength 0.951 and seasonal strength 0.5016; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.353); 7 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.795.
